messages.subject: How to get latest Shiny  (0.5.0.99 ?)
parts:
I am using R 3.0

I was happily using shiny (showed as 0.5.0.99 in packages list), then ...

I had a sporadic (unrepeatable) problem with a selectInput() ui becoming unresponsive to 'clicks'.  So I thought to get the latest shiny in case I had an older copy.

I did ...  

> install.packages("shiny")

and got a 'new' shiny package, but it showed as 0.5.0 in the packages list and did not contain actionButton() and the update routines that I make extensive use of.

So I did ...

>install_github("shiny", "rstudio" )

and got 

Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]) : 
  namespace 'httpuv' 1.0.5 is being loaded, but >= 1.0.6.2 is required

What is the proper method to install the lastest shiny version?

messages.author: 4245924341146ca2
messages.subject: Re: How to get latest Shiny  (0.5.0.99 ?)
parts:
OK.  I did a better search of this forum and found the answer.

Step 1: load latest httpuv with the (special) command:

install.packages("httpuv", repos=c(RStudio="http://rstudio.org/_packages", CRAN="http://cran.rstudio.com/"))

Step 2: get the latest shiny with...
